units.source_text: 我开始感觉百无聊赖时，父母眼中那个稀罕的我也慢慢变得无趣了。

en.t: When I began to feel utterly bored, the version of me that had seemed so precious in my parents' eyes gradually became dull as well.

units.source_text: 凡是寒暑假回家的人，我想都体会过这种心情吧。

en.t: I imagine anyone who goes home for summer or winter vacation has experienced this feeling.

units.source_text: 最初的一个星期被奉为上宾，好吃好喝好招待，

en.t: For the first week, you are treated like an honored guest, given good food, good drink, and every courtesy,

units.source_text: 但是高潮一过，家里人的热情就渐渐冷却了下来，

en.t: but once that high point passes, the family's warmth gradually cools,

units.source_text: 到了后来，往往就不那么热情了，感觉有你没你都无所谓似的。

en.t: and in the end they are often no longer so enthusiastic, as if it makes no difference whether you are there or not.

units.source_text: 在家期间，我也度过了这么一个高潮，

en.t: During my stay at home, I too passed through just such a high point,

units.source_text: 而且我每次回家，总会带回一种父母无法接受的东京味儿。

en.t: and every time I came home, I always brought back a certain Tokyo flavor that my parents could not accept.

units.source_text: 如同把天主教的气味带进儒者的家里一般，

en.t: It was like bringing the scent of Catholicism into the house of a Confucian scholar,

units.source_text: 我带回来的气味都是跟父母格格不入的。

en.t: for the atmosphere I brought back was utterly out of harmony with my parents.

units.source_text: 当然，我总是尽量掩饰，

en.t: Of course, I always tried to hide it as much as I could,

units.source_text: 但是已浸染在身的习气，怎样掩饰也会被他们发现。

en.t: but habits already soaked into me would be noticed by them no matter how I tried to conceal them.

units.source_text: 终于，我觉得在家待下去也没意思，

en.t: At last, I felt there was no pleasure in staying at home any longer,

units.source_text: 想提前回东京。

en.t: and I wanted to return to Tokyo ahead of schedule.

units.source_text: 幸而父亲的病情还是老样子，没有一点恶化的迹象。

en.t: Fortunately, my father's illness remained as it had been, with no sign at all of worsening.

units.source_text: 为了慎重起见，我特意从很远的地方请来高明的医生，

en.t: To be on the safe side, I went out of my way to summon a skilled doctor from far away,

units.source_text: 经过一番仔细的检查，也没有发现其他症状。

en.t: and after a careful examination, he still found no other symptoms.

units.source_text: 于是，我决定在寒假结束之前离开家乡。

en.t: So I decided to leave my hometown before the winter vacation ended.

units.source_text: 人情真是奇妙的东西，我一提出要走，父母都反对。

en.t: Human feeling is a strange thing; as soon as I said I would leave, both my parents objected.

units.source_text: “现在就要回去？

en.t: "You are going back already?

units.source_text: 不是还早吗？”

en.t: Isn't it still too soon?"

units.source_text: 母亲说。

en.t: my mother said.

units.source_text: “再住上四五天也来得及啊。”

en.t: "You would still have time even if you stayed four or five more days."

units.source_text: 父亲说。

en.t: my father said.

units.source_text: 我没有改变自己定下的回东京的日期。

en.t: I did not change the date I had set for returning to Tokyo.
